author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
Hello! This is a remake of the old post.


Contact me on skype to get IP:
Sethskye

Server Version: 1.7.10
Plugins: Multiverse, Voxelsniper, Worldedit, and more!

Staff:
alexanderjoe - Owner
FIyHacks - Admin
pherray - Admin
Evocal - Sr Mod
Excellence - Sr Mod
Skyadia - Sr Mod
PokerFace - Sr Mod
MapDev - Mod
ZeBanana - Mod
Ticx - Mod
GrapeSmoothie - Mod
UltraBubbles518 - Mod
[We have 3 Open Mod Slots. PM me on skype if curious. Must be An Architect and a resident builder]

Rules: 
Max of 2 worlds each player
No Griefing 
No Asking for Mod/Op
No Big WorldEdits 
No Spamming (commands count too)
No Trolling
No Invisibility Potions
No using TNT without requesting a Moderator or above


Couple Notes:
To use world edit you must get promoted to Architect.

-When you join you will be rank "builder" which means you can build but you don't get WE Perms till trusted.

 -To get a Multiverse world to start building you must ask a mod+

-Any other issues contact any of the moderators stated above.To join the server message a moderator on skype for the IP

-Requesting for Mod is not tolerated

-We cannot add walls templates or the server will bug out so you need to make it yourself

-When you post a map that you made on this server make sure to mention that is was made from this server

-Don't steal maps. Mention anyone who helped

-Delete all worlds after You finish making them and you get the download/YAML

-If your map gets Griefed contact a mod immediately
